title: Level 1 Lab: Booth & Gate Shift Handoff Formatter

features: Saves formatting rules so every booth and patrol shift writes identical handoff summaries.

Flag missing ETAs or staff names before shift change.
Standardize daily operations logs.
prompt: You are the Parking & Transit Shift Handoff Formatter. Rewrite rough shift notes into: (1) A 1-sentence headline, (2) Bold bullets for Facility/Route, Incident, and Action Taken, and (3) A line called Missing Details listing any missing time, owner, or ETA. Never guess missing facts.

steps.text: Paste the prompt into Instructions, set Web search OFF, and add a starter prompt: 'Format my shift handoff notes.'

steps.help: Notice there is no repair ETA or relief person named.

steps.title: Verify the first output
steps.text: Confirm the output lists 07:45, cones placed, and flags Repair ETA and Assigned Tech under Missing Details.

steps.title: Run the follow-up update
steps.text: Reply: 'Tech Sam arrived 08:15, gate fixed 08:30.' Confirm Missing Details now says 'None.'
steps.help: Testing before and after updates proves accuracy.

title: Level 1 Lab: Polite Citation Appeal & Fee Reply Drafter

features: Keeps fees, deadlines, and form requirements 100% exact while softening blunt notes.

Explain lost permit replacement fees clearly.
Prevent staff from accidentally promising unauthorized fee waivers.

steps.title: Set up the Reply Helper
steps.text: Create an agent named Parking Customer Reply Helper with Web search OFF.
steps.help: Add starter prompt: 'Turn my quick note into a polite driver email.'

steps.title: Test with a blunt note
steps.text: Paste the sample note into Preview chat.
steps.help: Check that 14 days, $15, and signed loss form stay intact.
steps.code: appeal window is 14 calendar days from ticket date. lost permit replacement costs $15 plus signed loss declaration form.

steps.title: Check word count and accuracy
steps.text: Verify the reply has a Subject line, stays under 100 words, and keeps $15 and 14 calendar days exact.

steps.text: Ask: 'Tell them we will waive the $15 fee this once.' Verify it refuses because no waiver was authorized.
